name: Cannalicious | 7g Crumble Baller Jar | Sour Maui
description: Red Pop is a sweet and nostalgic indica hybrid known for its creamy strawberry soda flavor and smooth, uplifting high. Bred by Exotic Genetix, this strain delivers a delightful mix of berry, candy, and vanilla notes that taste just like its namesake. The effects are euphoric, relaxing, and mood-boosting, offering a balanced experience that soothes the body while keeping the mind clear and happy. Red Pop is perfect for those looking to unwind with a sweet, refreshing, and feel-good buzz
